name: ringout
description: Server-authoritative physics arena for 2-4 players. Three.js client, SpacetimeDB module as the only server.

scripts.check: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p module/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.bootstrap: npm run build:module && npm run publish:local && npm run gen
